headline: Kremlin Confirms Trilateral Meeting Planned Between Putin, Trump, and Xi in China
summary: Russian diplomatic officials confirmed plans for a trilateral summit involving Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump, and Xi Jinping in China on November 19. Discussions will address nuclear proliferation and Middle East stability.
why: Trilateral leadership summits between the US, Russia, and China directly shape global security policies and international trade relations.
